segments.contextAfter: Use this property to set the title of the Back button when a view controller’s [`navigationItem`](uiviewcontroller/navigationitem.md) is the [`backItem`](uinavigationbar/backitem.md) of the navigation bar, in other words, when the Back button appears in the navigation bar of the next view controller.
